target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.excenter {i}) = EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.excenter {i}) (t.points i) (t.points k) ∧ EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points i) (t.points j) (t.excenter {i}) = EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.excenter {i}) (t.points j) (t.points k) + (Real.pi : Real.Angle) ∧ EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points i) (t.points k) (t.excenter {i}) = EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.excenter {i}) (t.points k) (t.points j) + (Real.pi : Real.Angle)
